name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 2014 in Intrusions
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK Enterprise techniques that the verified 2014 record supports: the techniques ATT&CK lists for the objects it ties to 2014 reports and events (G0001 Axiom, G0012 Darkhotel, G0022 APT3, G0027 Threat Group-3390, G0032 Lazarus Group for the Sony attack, G0034 Sandworm Team for CVE-2014-4114, G0035 Dragonfly, G0130 Ajax Security Team, S0016 P2P ZeuS, S0019 Regin, S0022 Uroburos, S0089 BlackEnergy and S0409 Machete) and the 2014 examples on the T1190 and T1212 pages, and behavior described by OpenSSL's, Microsoft's and Drupal's advisories, US-CERT's alerts on Shellshock, Backoff, Sony's toolset, crypto ransomware and NTP amplification, ICS-CERT's Havex and BlackEnergy alerts, Home Depot's and eBay's filings and Apple's statement, with Newscaster graded Reported. No 2014 source prints an ATT&CK id: ATT&CK was released publicly in May 2015. The 14 ATT&CK for ICS techniques are in the separate layer navigator/case-studies/chronicle-2014-ics.json. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_2014.md. Scores: 100 an ATT&CK object prints the id, 70 the source describes the behavior and the study assigns the id, 50 only a Reported source supports the behavior, 40 the mapping is Inferred.
